[IM]P C M AVR CL Q[VINTVLLUS AVG] ; [AP]OLLINI CONS [---]

Worn Roman radiate of Quintullus, dating from 270AD. This coin was struck in copper alloy and has a dull green patina. The obverse has a right facing radiate bust and the legend [IM]P C M AVR CL Q[VINTVLLUS AVG]. The reverse depicts Apollo and has the incomplete legend [AP]OLLINI CONS [---].
